payload.title: Record reliable per-classifier confidence calibration snapshots
payload.description: Audit and verify existing OOF temperature calibration on learned heads; fitted calibration must use only trusted training OOF predictions and propensity weights, never fit on audit/held-out or on the displayed rolling evaluation window. Record raw and calibrated final probability vectors, model/head identity and calibration provenance on every prediction; identify raw decision passthrough when no fitted head is selected. Per-classifier cycle-metrics must retain immutable ten-bin top-label reliability curves, counts, mean confidence, observed accuracy, ECE and Brier/log loss over the same latest 200 unique human-labeled pre-vote predictions used by ongoing metrics. Empty bins stay undefined, tiny samples visibly uncertain. Corrections/retractions create new snapshots, do not rewrite history. Optional raw-versus-calibrated comparisons require matched eligible samples and clear scope. Record sample IDs/window/version mix and cycle/event identity for auditability; recompute when window/config-relevant predictions change, not by silently rescoring old predictions. Existing calibration_metrics and UI changes are drafts; add integration/provenance specs and complete wiring before marking done.
